title: Current Affairs
subtitle: General Knowledge-II · CSS 2026
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Review carefully. The source scan for this subject is blurry, so some wording and keys may need your correction.

questions.text: What was the central agenda of Emmanuel Macron's 2025 visit to China?
questions.explanation: Macron's Dec 2025 trip focused on rebalancing EU–China trade.

questions.text: ________ is the author of "Essay on Population (1798)":
questions.explanation: Thomas Malthus, An Essay on the Principle of Population (1798).

questions.text: During the Trump-Modi summit, India emphasized which key priority for bilateral ties?

options.C: Uninterrupted fuel and energy supplies to India

questions.explanation: Best-effort key; energy security was India's stated priority.

questions.text: ________ got Nobel Peace Prize, 2025:
questions.explanation: María Corina Machado won the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.text: In 2025, conflict between Thailand and Cambodia erupted on the issue of:
questions.explanation: The July 2025 clashes stemmed from disputed border claims (incl. areas around border temples).

questions.text: On June 22, 2025, US B2 Bombers and Tomahawk missiles hit Fordow nuclear facility as part of:
questions.explanation: Operation Midnight Hammer struck Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan.

questions.text: ________ Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction is in vogue for 2015-2030.
questions.explanation: Sendai Framework 2015–2030 replaced the Hyogo Framework.

questions.text: The central idea of Anatol Lieven's book "Pakistan: A Hard Country" is:
questions.explanation: Lieven argues Pakistani society is far more resilient than assumed.

questions.text: The development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs is called:
questions.explanation: Brundtland Report (1987) definition.

questions.text: Doha Forum is an annual global forum held in Doha that gathers world leaders, policymakers, civil-society representatives, business leaders, media etc. Doha Forum and Doha Dialogue are, hence:

options.C: Doha Forum is part of Doha Dialogue

questions.explanation: Best-effort key; they are separate initiatives.

questions.text: ________ authored the book "Revenge of Geography".
questions.explanation: Written by Robert D. Kaplan (not listed).

questions.text: Which Pakistani economist contributed significantly towards development of Human Security Theory?
questions.explanation: Mahbub ul Haq framed human security in the 1994 UNDP HDR.

questions.text: Who authored seminal book "World Order"?
questions.explanation: Henry Kissinger, World Order (2014).

questions.text: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism is currently operational in the European Union (EU). It applies to:
questions.explanation: CBAM puts a carbon price on carbon-intensive imports.

questions.text: An economic model designed to eliminate waste and keep resources in use for as long as possible is known as:
questions.explanation: Circular economy = reduce, reuse, recycle.

questions.text: ________ will co-host the next year's COP-31.
questions.explanation: COP31 (2026): Türkiye hosts in Antalya; Australia leads negotiations.

questions.text: In a new report, ________ has urged world leaders to halt an "obsession" with energy source that fired the climate crisis.
questions.explanation: Best-effort key: Amnesty's late-2025 report urged ending the 'obsession' with fossil fuels.

questions.text: Advances in ________ are enabling treatments that are tailored specifically to an individual's makeup, significantly improving the effectiveness of therapies for conditions like cancer, cardiovascular disease, and mental health disorders.
questions.explanation: Genomic (precision) medicine tailors therapy to genes.

questions.text: On Inauguration day President Trump withdrew USA from:
questions.explanation: Executive orders on 20 Jan 2025 exited both the Paris Agreement and WHO.

questions.text: In May 2025, European Union lifted all economic sanctions against:
questions.explanation: EU lifted economic sanctions on Syria in May 2025.
